name: nodrift
description: Stop context loss and architectural drift across AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Stop context loss and architectural drift across AI coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Five skills: nodrift-sync for cross-agent handoff and collision prevention, nodrift-consultant for pre-coding architecture and BLUEPRINT.md, nodrift-standard for tech lead coding standards, nodrift-ui for frontend anti-slop and UX guardrails, nodrift-troubleshooting for root-cause analysis and debugging.
